subject: Coord: Executive intro + demo block — HexaPort CIO/VP availability and fallback
messages:
From: Jill Tan <jill.tan@hexaport.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.riley@hexaport.com, procurement@hexaport.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 23:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec intro and deep-dive — availability window

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for running point here. HexaPort is keen to see a short executive overview of Redwood followed by a technical deep-dive for our platform and security teams. CIO Mike Connors and VP Product Serena Park both indicated they can join, but their windows are tight.

Proposed structure: 20–25 min exec intro (Mike + Serena), 40–45 min technical/demo with Q&A. Total ~70 minutes.

Their current availability next week is narrow — best single block is:
 - Thu 30 Sep 09:30–11:00 BST (that’s 01:30–03:00 PDT) — not ideal for you, I realize.
 - Fri 1 Oct 14:00–15:30 BST (06:00–07:30 PDT) — preferable for us.

If those don't work, can you propose two US-friendly slots (early-morning PDT) plus an alternate shorter option where we split the exec intro and tech follow-up across two meetings?

Attaching a one-pager with business context. Also include any preferred attendees on your side (we want 1:1 exec alignment if possible).

Best,
Jill

Jill Tan
Head of Strategic Accounts | HexaPort
jill.tan@hexaport.com
+44 20 7946 0921

Attachments: hexa-customer-context.pdf (pdf)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Jill Tan <jill.tan@hexaport.com>, tom.riley@hexaport.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec intro and deep-dive — availability window

Jill — thanks, and appreciated the clarity on the audience.

We can absolutely accommodate the 70-minute format but understand exec calendars are tight. Quick notes from our side: Rafael Mendes (me) will lead the exec intro; Marissa Cole (VP Sales) will join for the commercial and next-steps portion; Vivek Kulkarni (Solutions Lead) will run the technical demo.

Two US-friendly options we can offer (all PDT):
 - Thu 30 Sep 05:30–07:00 PDT (14:30–16:00 BST) — earlier on your side than you suggested but workable if Mike can flex.
 - Fri 1 Oct 06:00–07:30 PDT (14:00–15:30 BST) — aligns with your Fri preference.

If you prefer to split: we can do a 25-min exec intro on Fri 1 Oct 06:00–06:25 PDT, then a separate 40-min technical follow-up later that afternoon (we'd propose 07:00–07:40 PDT). Splitting reduces risk of attendees needing to be present for full 70 min.

We can also run a short 20-min dry-run with Marissa and Vivek on Wed 30 Sep 08:00–08:20 PDT to ensure slides and SSO demo flow smoothly.

I attached a brief exec slide deck and a suggested agenda. Let me know which of the three approaches (single block Fri, single block Thu, split Fri + follow-up) works best for Mike and Serena and we'll lock a calendar invite with a fallback coverage plan.

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0126

Attachments: redwood-exec-brief.pdf (pdf); proposed-agenda.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@hexaport.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, Jill Tan <jill.tan@hexaport.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:47:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Exec intro and deep-dive — availability window

On Tue, 28 Sep 2027 at 08:02 -0700, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai wrote:
> We can also run a short 20-min dry-run with Marissa and Vivek on Wed 30 Sep 08:00–08:20 PDT

Thanks Rafael — quick update from our side: Mike can do the Fri 1 Oct block (14:00–15:30 BST) but only if we keep the executive intro tight (20 min) and limit the number of vendor slides — he's most interested in PoC risks, data residency, and SLA commitments. Serena will stay for the whole session.

Procurement is also looping in a single technical contact to evaluate logging/audit requirements.

The split approach might actually be cleaner: 20-min exec intro (Fri 1 Oct 14:00–14:20 BST / 06:00–06:20 PDT), followed by a 45-min technical demo at 14:30–15:15 BST (06:30–07:15 PDT). That gives a 10-minute buffer and is friendlier to exec attention spans.

Can you confirm you can shorten the exec intro content to focus on value and risk mitigations? If yes, we'll lock the split schedule and confirm attendees.

—Tom
Tom Riley
Enterprise Programs | HexaPort

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Jill Tan <jill.tan@hexaport.com>, tom.riley@hexaport.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 07:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec intro and deep-dive — availability window

Rafael — quick note: I can compress the exec deck to 3 slides (vision, business outcomes, headcount/ops ask) + one slide on risk mitigations (SLA/KMS/segmentation). Vivek, please be prepared to cover data residency, logging, and the KV-cache isolation strategy in the tech segment.

I can take the first 5 minutes for contract/trajectory context and hand off to you for the quick exec ask. I'll also block the dry-run for Wed 30 Sep 08:00 PDT for 20 minutes — let's keep it tight and rehearse the hand-off.

I'll add these calendar holds and include a fallback: if Mike can't join live, we'll record the demo and then set up a 30-min follow-up with him the following week.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(628) 555-0192

Attachments: calendar-invite.ics (ics)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: Jill Tan <jill.tan@hexaport.com>, tom.riley@hexaport.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, procurement@hexaport.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Exec intro (20m) + Tech demo (45m) — Fri 1 Oct (split schedule)

Jill / Tom — locking the split plan per your preference. Final details below: 

1) Exec intro (20 minutes) - Fri 1 Oct 06:00–06:20 PDT / 14:00–14:20 BST - Leads: Rafael (exec framing) + Marissa (commercial ask / minimal slides) - Focus: top-line business wins, PoC success criteria, SLA highlights

2) Short break (10 minutes)

3) Technical demo + Q&A (45 minutes) - Fri 1 Oct 06:30–07:15 PDT / 14:30–15:15 BST - Lead: Vivek (solutions + security deep-dive), Rafael for transitions - Focus: data residency, audit logs, token-level billing, deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private)

Logistics: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/hexaport-demo-232 (dial-in included)
Calendar invites: sent and accepted by our side. I've attached the cleaned exec deck and the agenda. If Mike will only join the first 20 minutes, we'll record the demo and follow up with an executive highlights memo and short Q&A window.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.

Rafael

Rafael Mendes
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
